title.narrative: Using Law for Environmental Advocacy and Defence (U-LEAD)

description.narrative: The Overall Objective of the project is to enhance access to justice in Turkey through the use of human rights law to protect the environment and hold accountable those that breach environmental human rights. This will be achieved through establishing and supporting an informal but active network of human rights and environment defenders and enable them to use human rights law to defend the environment (SO1) and through raising awareness before national and international authorities.
